titles.title: Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 3495) to amend the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to clarify the definition of employee as it relates to direct sellers and real estate agents, and for other purposes, and providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 5267) to preserve the franchise business model.

Providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 3495) to amend the Fair Labor Standards Act of 1938 to clarify the definition of employee as it relates to direct sellers and real estate agents, and for other purposes, and providing for consideration of the bill (H.R. 5267) to preserve the franchise business model.

action.text: The House Committee on Rules reported an original measure, H. Rept. 119-881, by Mrs. Houchin.
The resolution provides for consideration of H.R. 3495 and H.R. 5267 under a closed rule with one hour of debate and one motion to recommit on each bill.

calendar.text: Placed on the House Calendar, Calendar No. 93.
